siteUrl.description: Site URL for the meeting template.

templateType.description:
Meeting template type.
 * `meeting` - Webex meeting.
 * `webinar` - Webex webinar.

isDefault.description: Whether or not the meeting template is a default template.

isStandard.description: Whether or not the meeting template is a standard template.

meeting.description: Meeting object which is used to create a meeting by the meeting template. Please note that the meeting object should be used to create a meeting immediately after retrieval since the `start` and `end` may be invalid quickly after generation.
